title: Mastering CSS Flexbox Layouts
subtitle: A Practical Guide to Flexible Web Design

title: Understanding Flex Containers
bullets: Define a flex container using display:flex
Enable flexible layout for child items

title: Flex Container
body: A flex container establishes a flexible formatting context for its direct children. It activates the flex layout algorithm.

title: Container Code
description: Basic flex container declaration with common properties.

title: Flex Direction
body: Flex direction determines the orientation of the main axis. Options include row, row-reverse, column, and column-reverse.

title: Direction Code
description: Switching main axis orientation using flex-direction.

title: Flex Wrap
body: Flex wrap controls whether items stay on a single line or wrap onto multiple lines when space is limited.

title: Wrap Code
description: Managing line breaks with flex-wrap property.

title: Justify Content
body: Justify-content distributes free space along the main axis, affecting how items are positioned horizontally (or vertically).

title: Justify Code
description: Various ways to align items along the main axis.

title: Align Items
body: Align-items aligns flex items on the cross axis within a single line, providing vertical (or horizontal) centering.

title: Align Code
description: Cross‑axis alignment options for flex items.

title: Align Content
body: Align-content works like align-items but for multi‑line flex containers, distributing space between lines.

title: Content Code
description: Managing spacing between rows when flex-wrap is enabled.

title: Summary
bullets: align-items handles cross‑axis within a line

title: Flex Grow
body: Flex-grow defines how much a flex item will expand relative to others when extra space is available.

title: Grow Code
description: Using flex-grow to allocate remaining space.

title: Flex Shrink
body: Flex-shrink determines how a flex item reduces its size when the container becomes too small.

title: Shrink Code
description: Controlling reduction of item size under overflow.

title: Flex Basis & Order
body: Flex-basis sets the initial main‑axis size before free space distribution. Order changes visual ordering without altering HTML.

title: Basis Code
description: Defining starting size and reordering items.

title: Summary
bullets: flex-basis sets initial size; order reorders items
